'''Test environment JX967A24''' was the designation applied to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] by a [[Unidentified Iokath species|technologically-advanced species]] that dominated the region many [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Species/Legends|species]], which tested weapons projects on unsuspecting worlds, deployed a number of new designs in a "test" against environment JX967A24, which saw them [[Invasion of test environment JX967A24|deploy]] numerous [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] waves and other forces against the planet's natives. The natives deployed "single-pilot aerial countermeasures" against the invaders, but ultimately surrendered after 28 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]]; despite receiving a "compensation package" from the invaders, their infrastructure was so severely damaged that the invading species estimated it would take at least 2,000 years before the environment was ready to be "tested" again.

==Behind the scenes==
Test environment JX967A24 was mentioned in the Codex entry "History of Iokath: Entry 1 in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'',<ref name="Codex" /> a [[2016]] Digital Expansion for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Launch">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20161202-1|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne: Now Live!}}</ref>
